tasks.gr10-combined-transactions-reconciliatio: Topic: Combined transactions and reconciliations. Cover combined cash and credit transactions, debtors reconciliation, creditors reconciliation, control accounts, subsidiary ledgers. Ask about reconciliation adjustments, matching, error-spotting.
tasks.gr10-payroll-year-end-procedures: Topic: Payroll and year-end procedures. Cover salaries and wages, deductions, employer contributions, SJ, WJ, pre/post-adjustment trial balance, final accounts. Ask about payroll calculations, adjustment entries, final-account formats.
